Fantastic addition to the garden. The auto-retract mechanism works smoothly every time with just a gentle tug and no sticking or jamming. Mounting it was straightforward, and being able to swivel it 180 degrees makes reaching every corner of the garden effortless. Highly recommend! The casing feels solid and weather-resistant. The hose locks securely at whatever length you pull it to, and retracts at a safe, controlled speed.

This is a great item and I saw it in my son-in-laws garden. I bought mine on the promise that he'd install it for me......it is still waiting in its box 🤣 But i recommend the item and the perfect service.

This thing is beautiful. Well constructed. Pretty easy to put up. First time took a few. But now it's simple. 16.5 foot is a massive space 10.5 foot standing lots of usable space. We use it mainly in the backyard for fun nights out. With our VEVOR 22 foot blow up movie screen. Also plan to use it for campsite camping. This is not something you want to lift for long. It's very heavy. We have two queen size mattress and a 50" tv. And that only takes up less than half the space. The green is nice. Stealthy you can't see the lights on or the tv from outside. It has rained. And without treatment no leaks. But I am going to canvas treat it for better uv protection. And seal the seams. Typical new canvas tent preventative maintenance.

I purchased these to move my boat in around in my garage, boat is a tracker 175 TXW and they hold the weight no problem, you can move it around with ease by yourself. These are heavy duty and well built and would recommend to anyone.
Overall work fine, the wheels are a hard material, rubber would have allowed it to move more freely
